# Noto Serif CJK SC Regular

Unmodified upstream OTF, embedded in the native document renderer for deterministic
CJK fallback. No runtime font download or user-installed font dependency.

- Source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk
- Commit: f8d157532fbfaeda587e826d4cd5b21a49186f7c
- Path: Serif/OTF/SimplifiedChinese/NotoSerifCJKsc-Regular.otf
- SHA256: 2a2eae2628df83556c54018c41e20fa532c1b862c5256ae8b3f23feb918d12ca
- Size: 24,543,080 bytes
- License: ../../licenses/NotoSerifCJK-OFL.txt (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

The existing math fonts remain first in the font book. CJK text falls back to this
face. Glyphs absent from all bundled faces still produce an explicit diagnostic.
